args.body: In the existing SQLite seller assessment, compare the conditional paid offer directly with the verified free download. Identify the concrete buyer outcome the paid package adds and the evidence for that difference. An original replacement fixture resolves a redistribution choice by itself. If that is the only observed difference, finish the seller decision and keep the listing draft conditional on a defensible paid benefit and documented seller and product approval. Reuse the committed activation and fee captures. Read back the decision and close under valid ownership with a lesson. No signup, listing or deployment.

description: Treasury has CAD 0 available and no verified revenue. Commercial feedback is available but contains five unclassified sources and no classified requests, so demand remains unknown. Prioritize a buyer-specific SQLite diagnostic using the existing tool. Keep the marketplace assessment moving independently by testing what a paid offer would add to the free download. Marketplace activation depends on seller and product approval. Revisit activation when there is evidence those requirements can be met.
